en: Error occurs when another game client or another process is already executing HackShield. Since the HackShield vr.3.1 has been improved to allow HackShield running in a multi-process environment, this does not occur in the newer version clients. (Value = 0x201)
zh: 当其他游戏客户端或其他进程已在运行HackShield时会发生此错误。HackShield vr.3.1已改进为支持多进程环境运行，新版客户端中不会出现此错误。(Value = 0x201)

en: Error occurs when the game client is executed in the Compatibility Mode provided by Windows XP. Game execution in Compatibility Mode is judged as a user with ill intentions, so program must be ended and restarted. (Value = 0x004)
zh: 当游戏客户端在Windows XP提供的兼容模式下运行时会发生此错误。以兼容模式运行游戏会被视为恶意用户，因此必须结束并重新启动程序。(Value = 0x004)

en: Error occurs when the system has already finished initialization through calling _AhnHS_Initialize. _AhnHS_Initialize can only be called once at the program initialization stage, and cannot be called repeatedly. This can only occur in the developmental process, so no other processes need to be taken. (Value = 0x001)
zh: 当系统已通过调用_AhnHS_Initialize完成初始化时会发生此错误。_AhnHS_Initialize只能在程序初始化阶段调用一次，不能重复调用。此错误只会在开发过程中出现，无需其他处理。(Value = 0x001)

en: Error occurs when the pointer of the Callback function is set incorrectly or if the license key value is NULL. This can only occur in the developmental process, so no other processes need to be taken. (Value = 0x002)
zh: 当回调函数指针设置不正确或许可证密钥值为NULL时会发生此错误。此错误只会在开发过程中出现，无需其他处理。(Value = 0x002)

en: Error occurs when the game code set to initialization function' s parameter and the license key value do not match the actual values. This can only occur in the developmental process, so no other processes need to be taken. (Value = 0x100)
zh: 当初始化函数参数中设置的游戏代码或许可证密钥值与实际值不匹配时会发生此错误。此错误只会在开发过程中出现，无需其他处理。(Value = 0x100)

en: Error occurs when the hack prevention function Driver fails initialization. If driver initialization fails, the hack prevention function will not work normally, so program should be ended, and restarted. (Value = 0x102)
zh: 当防黑客功能驱动初始化失败时会发生此错误。驱动初始化失败时，防黑客功能将无法正常运行，因此应结束并重新启动程序。(Value = 0x102)

en: Error occurs while Debugger is running on the system. If this occurs during the developmental process, exclude option AHNHS_CHKOPT_KDTRACER. If this occurs in the version distributed to users, end game program and debugger, and re-execute as there is a possibility of hack attacks. (Value = 0x105)
zh: 当系统上有调试器运行时会发生此错误。如果发生在开发过程中，请排除AHNHS_CHKOPT_KDTRACER选项。如果发生在正式发布版本中，请结束游戏程序和调试器后重新运行，因为存在被黑客攻击的可能性。(Value = 0x105)

en:
#eWelcome to the Test World#n
This is a place that has been created in order to test
content that is planned to be revised or added in the real MapleStory World.
As such, the following limitations apply.

#b1. In the Test World, character development has been
set on "easy" for the sake of testing. This info 
will not be applied in the real MapleStory World.
2. Character information from the Test World will never
be shared with the real MapleStory World. 
3. Character information in the Test World can be reset
without any notice or agreement from the user.
4. The Test World service may be stopped without
any notice.
5. Content tested here may not be
applied to the real MapleStory World.
6. When the tested contents are added to the real MapleStory World, there may be
modifications made to the stats.
zh:
#e欢迎来到测试服#n

zh: [精神周活动] 让NPC卡珊德拉的蜡烛燃烧1小时，即可获得“雅典娜的猫头鹰”奖励。（10级以上）

en: [Spirit Week Event] You can trade in your scroll with a scroll that has a higher Success Rate of 5% from NPC Cassandra. (above Lv.10)
zh: [精神周活动] 可以在NPC卡珊德拉处，用您的卷轴换取成功率高5%的卷轴。（10级以上）

en: [Spirit Week Event] You will be given a higher chance of acquiring desirable weapons and armor, as well as a 5% discount on selected potions at the shop.
zh: [精神周活动] 获得心仪武器和防具的几率更高，商店内部分药水还有5%折扣。

en: [Spirit Week Event] You will be rewarded the "Teleport Rock" if you keep NPC Cassandra's Candle burning for 1 hour. (above Lv.10)
zh: [精神周活动] 让NPC卡珊德拉的蜡烛燃烧1小时，即可获得“传送石”奖励。（10级以上）

en: [Spirit Week Event] You will receive 2x Party Bonus EXP.
zh: [精神周活动] 组队奖励经验值变为2倍。

en: [Spirit Week Event] You will receive an additional 30% Bonus EXP for the first 5 quests you complete today. (Quests with less than 1 Bonus EXP excluded)
zh: [精神周活动] 今天最先完成的5个任务将额外获得30%奖励经验值。（奖励经验值不足1的任务除外）
